Recovery Workbench Party and Customer Master Data Design v4
Next version of Recovery Workbench Party and Customer Master Data Design v3.xlsx. Realignment to Architecture v5 and the 19 services (D-RCV-60; ADR-013, ADR-014, DP-01 and DP-05).
Tool: T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash.
Change log
v4, 22 November 2026, D-RCV-60 microservice realignment, T3 Code / OpenCode / DeepSeek v4.1 Flash
What changed in v4
1. Party fields: three columns are appended at the end - Owning service, Target schema and Access rule. Columns A to G keep their letters, positions and values, and all 52 field rows are unchanged.
2. Match rules: two columns are appended, Target component and Owning service. Rules M1 to M5 and both narrative rows are unchanged.
3. Service ownership: this sheet is new. One row for each service that owns a table or a view in this design, with its schema, epic, wave, contract entry point and field count.
4. Read paths: this sheet is new. It states how each consumer gets party data: ACE party data only through rwb-source-data, case_party through rwb-case, the panel entry through rwb-partner.
5. Read me: this sheet is new and carries the two header lines of Template and Rules R8.1 and this change log.
What did not change

Every entity, field, data type, physical type, source, source field and meaning, and every match rule, condition, result and action, is copied character for character from v3. The design statement still holds: a party is an ACE customer read through a view plus one party_ext row, and there is no local party or contact_point master table.
The workbook carries no release date, so no date is marked (tentative) and no date is changed.
Counts
Party fields: 52 rows over 7 entities - case_party 6, v_ace_customer 13, party_ext 5, v_ace_contact 9, v_ace_ca_relation 5, contact_point_ext 7, partner 7.
Owned per service: P1 39 (v_ace_customer 13, v_ace_contact 9, v_ace_ca_relation 5, party_ext 5, contact_point_ext 7), P3 6 (case_party), S9 7 (partner). Total 52.
Match rules: 5. M1 to M4 run in ACE ingestion and are served by the rwb-source-data view contract (P1); M5 runs in the rwb-partner partner master (S9).
Ownership basis

Owners are the Ownership Map v1 sheet Tables, row by row: case_party P3, party_ext P1, contact_point_ext P1, partner S9. The three recovery.v_ace_* views are not table rows in the map; they are P1 because only rwb-source-data holds SELECT on the 30 views and owns the view contract (Architecture v5 slides 35, 37 and 41; DP-05).

The Tier 2 columns of v_ace_customer arrive with RWB-P1-ACE001-DB (legacy RWB-ACE-001, disposition Split (rework), wave 1). The masking policy is P4 by owner (legacy RWB-E1-037, slices RWB-PLT-E1037-CON and RWB-P4-E1037-CON) and is applied in rwb-source-data.
Open points

CG-B-DATA-22-1 to CG-B-DATA-22-7 and ASM-B-DATA-22-1 to ASM-B-DATA-22-7 are candidate rows in _work/msr/gaps and _work/msr/assumptions. Step D1 numbers them GAP-nnnn and ASM-nnnn and rewrites every citation.
